name: windows-defender-quickscan
title: Run a Defender quick scan
description: Runs a Microsoft Defender quick scan (Start-MpScan -ScanType QuickScan). It takes a few minutes and the computer is slower meanwhile; the scan itself runs in the Defender service, so it cannot be stopped from here once started. Threats found are listed by name (never by file path).
measure: if (-not $s) { Add-ArhBlocker 'Microsoft Defender is not available on this computer'; Set-ArhPlan $false 'Nothing to do'; exit 0 }
Set-ArhPlan $true 'Run a quick scan (a few minutes; the computer is slower meanwhile)'
apply: if ($t) { Add-ArhWarning ('Threat found: ' + $t.ThreatName) } else { Add-ArhWarning "Threat found: id $($d.ThreatID)" }
